decisive_items: intraepidermal neoplasm consisting of pagetoid cells
Numerous reactive dendritic HMB-45–positive melanocytes scattered among tumor cells
response.rationale: Axillary pigmented plaque with pagetoid cells and CK7/EMA positivity is diagnostic of extramammary Paget disease; HMB-45-positive melanocytes are reactive, not melanocytic neoplasia.
